First, it introduces a unique 'manga-themed' hotel experience at Quintessa Hotel Fukuoka Tenjin Comic & Books, showcasing its amenities and extensive manga library. Second, it promotes the 'Airporter' luggage delivery service, providing a call-to-action for viewers to participate in a giveaway for free luggage transport between airports and hotels.
